fusions.name: Leveling Rune
fusions.desc: Brings a rune of force down around you, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Closing Gavel
fusions.desc: Brings down a gavel of force that deals 24 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Mallet of Making
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 12 seconds. A conjured maul fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 5 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattened Defences
fusions.desc: Your arcane attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
